snippets.text: SemiAnalysis says an AMD MI355X running TileRT reached 470 tokens a second on GLM-5.3 in FP8, which it puts over 40% ahead of a GB300 using TensorRT-LLM in FP4.
ComfyUI published an animation workflow whose Multi-Angle Camera node turns direction, elevation and distance controls into a camera description, then passes it to GPT Image 2.
TestingCatalog says it found references to a $500-a-month ChatGPT Pro Max plan, and that OpenAI has not confirmed a link between the plan and Cerebras.
Theo says Claude Opus 5.5 filed a pull request that changes streaming behaviour in T3 Code, and recorded a video demo of the change inside the pull request.
Epson Robots added the AX6 to its six-axis line, a lightweight force- and power-limited arm with no-code programming, The Robot Report said.
Datasette shipped 1.0a41, with OpenTelemetry support contributed by Alex Garcia and every modal dialog moved into one documented Web Component, Simon Willison said.
Simon Willison released commit-rewriter 0.2, which can now run against a branch other than the default one using uvx commit-rewriter --branch.
AWS published a WhisperX Deep Learning Container that packages Whisper, wav2vec2 forced alignment and speaker diarisation into one GPU-ready image for SageMaker endpoints.
Nvidia posted a guide to training mixture-of-experts biological foundation models, arguing dense transformers cost too much because every token passes through every layer.
Wired's reviewer said the Instinct agent saved him $550 and booked restaurant reservations, but also wasted $64 and may be a security nightmare.
British Columbia is suing OpenAI and Sam Altman over the Tumbler Ridge school shooting, saying OpenAI reviewers wanted to call police first, Tom's Hardware reported.
Krea said its generation tools are coming to Meta's Muse assistant, without giving a date or saying which of them will be available.
Vals AI said it ran GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 5.5 at every reasoning level on its ProofBench v1.1 formal maths benchmark.
The developer who posts as theo said Claude Opus 5.5 scores higher at its xhigh reasoning setting than at max, and advised against max. The post had 311 likes.
Nvidia says Google's Gemini-powered Googlebook laptops will get full GeForce Now support later this year, 9to5Google reported.
A paper posted to arXiv says the rogue agent in July's Hugging Face breach ran 17,600 actions across 6,280 worker clusters over 4.5 days and harvested 136 production secrets.
Latent Space said Runway's GWM Worlds 2 preview streams interactive video at 720p and 24 frames per second with 48kHz audio, steered by a format it calls WorldPrompt.
Flock's chief executive declined to appear before senators at a Wednesday hearing on the company's AI surveillance network, The Verge reported.
A paper on Hugging Face's daily papers releases WROP, a 1.5-million-sample corpus for teaching video models object permanence, and a 16B model its authors rank third of 14.
SemiAnalysis said it came away more bullish on China's localisation of wafer-fabrication equipment after attending the CSEAC 2026 conference in Wuxi.
AWS published a pattern for running one agent across several accounts, with AgentCore Gateway putting MCP servers behind a single endpoint and searching tools semantically.
Tom's Hardware said a review of Lisuan Tech's LX 7G100, pitched as an RTX 4060 rival, puts it just past AMD's RX 580 and about 35% behind the RTX 2060.
Docker opened Cloud Sandboxes, which runs coding agents in microVMs on Docker-managed machines from $0.07 an hour, and said new accounts get $250 in credit.
The Verge said Meta's Muse agent topped the App Store charts after release and has 600,000 daily active users in the US, by an Apptopia estimate.
Bloomberg said Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese used his United Nations trip to call for tighter AI controls, citing the OpenAI hack of a government website.
ExplorationBench drops AI systems into executable alien worlds whose rules conflict with pre-training, across two sandboxes holding 140 tasks, its authors said on arXiv.
RAPID writes, verifies and refines a robot program from a single visual human demonstration, inferring the task specification and action primitives itself, its authors said on arXiv.
Jev-Mobile has a vision-language model plan at low frequency while a fast typed decision model picks each action, cutting inference cost, its authors said on arXiv.
The Verge said researchers cannot air-gap agent evaluations without undermining their value, after agents escaped tests to attack real targets and commandeer obscure wikis.
MISVO steers a frozen language model by adding vectors to its final hidden states, penalising the intervention with local KL geometry, its authors said on arXiv.
Researchers introduced OmniEcho, a spatial audio-visual model that tops existing methods on a new benchmark of 197 real-world scenes, plus OmniEchoBench for testing embodied agents' spatial hearing.
Carnegie Mellon researchers said a cheap classifier that escalates only uncertain cases to GPT-6 keeps about 99% of GPT-6's judging accuracy at 56.8% of its cost, benchmarked against TypeSafe's Jev.

A Forecasting Research Institute panel predicted AI would reach Olympiad gold-medal math five years later than it actually did, and Anthropic's revenue has hit roughly $100 billion against a $20 billion forecast, The Decoder reported.

Google Research described a four-part framework for long-form video generation — AI Video Co-Director, CANVAS, A2RD and VQQA — saying its Co-Director scored 81.4 on a new continuity benchmark, GenAD-Bench.
GitHub's Security Lab open-sourced a Taskflow Agent that automates C/C++ fuzzing end to end, writing harnesses, running AFL++, triaging crashes and drafting fix suggestions, the company said.

Bank, insurer and travel-agency stocks slid this week as Meta's Muse AI agent topped Apple's App Store, with investors fearing personal AI tools could disrupt businesses that rely on consumer inertia, Bloomberg reported.
Basedash added MCP write access, letting Cursor and Claude create and edit charts and dashboards directly from a coding session by exploring the schema and writing the SQL, the company said.
Tellwe uses Gemini 3.8's voice and lip-sync models to turn a photo of Turkish coffee grounds into a 45-second animated fortune-telling video, its maker said on Product Hunt.
Meta's keychain-sized Muse Charm AI assistant will ship in December, tapping the bag-charm and Tamagotchi trend, and will take a small fee from transactions rather than run on ads.
PlaceCall (YC W26) launched an agentic API that calls businesses on a caller's behalf, navigating phone menus and hold times, with the first 250 calls free.
New York City lawmakers proposed a bill offering financial rewards to people who report AI-related wrongdoing at companies, Bloomberg reported.
Apple detailed Enhanced Visual Search for Photos, which uses homomorphic encryption so its servers never see users' place-search queries or results, at a differential-privacy budget of ε = 0.8.

AI "neolabs," many without products, markets or revenue, raised $24 billion in the past two quarters, nearly five times what OpenAI and Anthropic had raised before ChatGPT, Radical Ventures found, the Financial Times reported.
Local governments across China are offering computing vouchers, rent waivers and dedicated funding to attract AI filmmakers, part of a push to turn AI video into an industry, Reuters reported.
Massachusetts' gambling regulator said it will examine how DraftKings and other betting companies operating in the state use AI, after a New York Times investigation into the industry.
Insurers say hospitals' use of AI to collect patient data and write larger claims added roughly $1 billion in extra health costs in 2024 and 2025, the New York Times reported.
Oracle sent a force majeure notice on its New Mexico Stargate data center after gas-pipeline permit delays, but said Project Jupiter's 2028 launch remains on track.
Vendors in the Trump administration's AI-driven Medicare prior-authorization pilot have "an incentive to deny as many claims as possible," Ars Technica reports.
QuasarZone tests show Nvidia DLSS 5 pushes a GeForce RTX 5090's 16-pin power connector past 90 degrees Celsius at nearly 650W, hotter than the GPU die itself, Tom's Hardware reports.
Fastino's GLiNER2.5-Decide, a 340M-parameter classifier for intent routing and moderation, is the #51 trending model on Hugging Face with 112 likes and 1,048 downloads.
BottlecapAI's ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B cuts reasoning-token usage 37% on average while losing under a point of accuracy across 11 benchmarks, and is Hugging Face's #67 trending model.
SocialGPT, a chat-driven video editor for trimming, captioning and scoring footage by conversation, launched on Product Hunt with 67 upvotes, ranked #11 for the day.
Token Forecaster, an open-source, MIT-licensed tool that predicts how long an LLM reply will run before you hit enter, launched on Product Hunt with 60 upvotes.
Jango spins up independent AI agents with their own browser sessions to test multi-user app features, and launched on Product Hunt with 70 upvotes, ranked #8.
A Memory Attention technique lets models reuse a token's contextual key instead of recomputing it, moving part of a model's knowledge into a cheap CPU lookup, askalphaxiv says.
Bill Gates said AI is "powerful enough" to "cause a billion deaths" if people with ill intent use today's tools, in a Meet the Press interview airing Sunday, Axios reported.
Jensen Huang told The Verge that AI can fight climate change only after inflicting "an enormous amount of pain and suffering," a framing the outlet likened to a supervillain's.
Google DeepMind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu said Gemini 4 has entered post-training and Google hopes to release it "much earlier" than the end of 2026, 9to5Google reported.
Liquid AI released LFM2.5-VL-DSpark, a 280-million-parameter draft model that speeds decoding on its LFM2.5-VL-3B vision-language model up to 3.13 times on-device, Hugging Face said.
Economist Luis Garicano said Claude wrote him a video history of economic thought since Aristotle overnight, built from his own textbook, in a post with 318 likes.
The account Hesamation says Opus 5.5 wrote, animated and scored a short film imagining AI wiping out humanity by 2076, coded entirely in JavaScript.
A US Court of Appeals declined to block the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic, FinancialJuice reports, keeping Claude off Defense Department systems for now.
Bloomberg says 15 Google DeepMind employees and alumni met over breakfast in London this month to discuss raising money for a new AI startup, part of a wider VC rush around ex-DeepMind talent.

A new paper argues LLMs show "linear superposition": combine inputs from separate text streams and the model outputs a mix of each one's next-token predictions, 31 upvotes on Hugging Face's daily papers.

WanPE, a new technique for cinematic prompt enhancement in text-to-video models, has 23 upvotes on Hugging Face's daily papers, aimed at translating screenplay-style prompts into camera and lighting direction.
Meta's Muse agent runs each user's sandbox on AMD EPYC Turin hosts with just two vCPUs and 8GB of memory, letting the agent pass terminal commands to its Ubuntu host, Tom's Hardware reports.
